description: This file defines an abstract base class for testing Roslyn diagnostic analyzers within the Orleans project. It provides infrastructure for compiling test code, running analyzers, and verifying diagnostics, specifically targeting Orleans code analysis rules.

classes.name: DiagnosticAnalyzerTestBase`1
classes.description: Abstract base class for testing Roslyn diagnostic analyzers for Orleans, providing methods for compiling code, running analyzers, and verifying diagnostics.

methods.name: CreateDiagnosticAnalyzer
methods.description: Creates an instance of the diagnostic analyzer being tested; can be overridden for customization.

methods.name: AssertNoDiagnostics
methods.description: Asserts that analyzing the provided source code produces no diagnostics.

methods.name: GetDiagnosticsAsync
methods.description: Compiles source code with optional usings and returns diagnostics.

methods.name: GetDiagnosticsFullSourceAsync
methods.description: Creates a compilation for the source code, runs analyzers, and returns diagnostics.

methods.name: CreateProject
methods.description: Sets up an in-memory Roslyn project with references and source code for testing.
